name: Mountain run strength endurance 60
description: A long steady steep climb at power-hike pace: builds the climbing endurance that uphill mountain runs and trail races rely on.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Steady steep climb
steps.notes: RPE 5-6. Even effort; do not drift faster.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
